reply.text:
Getting shredded by June is a reasonable goal, and I can help you get there on the training side. Shredded is mostly a nutrition and body composition question, though, and a target like that depends on your current bodyweight, your activity and what you are eating. The app works out calorie and macro targets on its Targets screen from your numbers, so that's the right place to set your intake.

On the training side, the goal means keeping your strength while you lean out, so we keep your main lifts heavy and add conditioning on top. Tell me what you're training right now and what you want to prioritise, and I'll get your recent sessions and goals pulled up so we can see where you start from.
